test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select "No substitution required".

She __prepares an unique__ dish in the cooking competition and won it.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. prepared a unique .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence uses the past tense **"won"**, so the verb **"prepare" **should also be in the **past tense (prepared)** to maintain tense consistency.
 
• The article **"a"** should be used before the word **"unique"** because "unique" starts with a **consonant sound**.

Correct sentence: *She **prepared a unique** dish in the cooking competition and won it*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Consistency in Tense:**

 
 
• Ensure that all verbs in the sentence agree in tense to maintain clarity and coherence.
 
• Example: She prepared (past) a unique dish and won (past) the competition.
 
 
 
• **Article Usage:**
 
 
• Use "a" before words that begin with a consonant sound, and "an" before words that begin with a vowel sound.
 
• Example: a unique (consonant sound), an apple (vowel sound).
